observations: The page number «XXIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «IV*» on the right.

L15, N03, N06: the three signs for zero are printed as a Greek small tau, τ, a narrow oval with a crossbar, θ, and the figure 0 with a bar above it, {ov:0} (transcribed {ov:0}). L17 «XXX0» and «XX0» and L19 «0» are the figure zero without a bar. L15: «theta ?», the question mark, upright, after a thin space of 10 px.

N07-N10: the abbreviations and their expansions are set in a heavier italic than the other italics of the notes (strokes measured on the scan: horizontal runs of ink, mean 5.3-5.6 px in «Dakaicae», «Theniae», «Puncta», «Minuta», 4.9 px in «Min.», against 4.3-4.6 px in «Prologus», «Ocreati» and «Sec.»); transcribed as bold italic, «Sec.» (N10) as italic. The distinction for «Min.» is the least certain.
Marks not transcribed: a speck at the right margin beside L07, after «oft».

critical_notes.evidence: the abbreviation of «zum Beispiel» is printed «z. B.» elsewhere (N06 of this page); the point after the B, at the end of the line, is not printed
